Pose - Floating or Hovering.name: Pose - Floating or Hovering
Pose - Floating or Hovering.description:
🕴️ Pose: Floating or Hovering
Suspended in the air, hovering above the ground by Quirk or support gear.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Floating or Hovering.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, show the character suspended in a stable hover with relaxed frame-visible limbs and a subtle sense of weightlessness. Visible ground clearance appears only when the selected frame includes it. Female: the line stays long, shoulders relaxed low. Male: shoulders level and set through the hover. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own suspension.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
